title: Variational Optimal Control for Diffusion Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2610.37146v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sampling-time guidance and reward-based post-training act on different variables but share a core geometric objective: realizing an output-space improvement through a generative model. We organize both around a Jacobian pullback evaluated with respect to either the current noisy state or the trainable parameters. Formulating current-state conditional variational optimal control (VOC) yields Variational Optimal Guidance (VOG), which transports a terminal reward proxy into a covariance-weighted sampling correction. Under a linear-subspace denoising model, the exact pullback has no component normal to the data subspace. Distilled Variational Optimal Control (DVOC) realizes the parameter-space counterpart of this local control principle: projected reward ascent constructs a bounded endpoint displacement within a local trust region, and a sparse, forward-pinned Euler surrogate transports it to LoRA parameters. Empirically, VOG reduces DiT

translated_title: 扩散引导的变分最优控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.37146v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：采样时引导与基于奖励的后训练作用于不同的变量，但共享一个核心的几何目标：通过生成模型实现输出空间的改进。我们将两者统一组织在一个雅可比回拉（Jacobian pullback）框架下，该回拉可以相对于当前含噪状态或可训练参数进行求值。通过对当前状态条件变分最优控制（VOC）进行形式化，我们得到了变分最优引导（VOG），它将终端奖励代理转化为协方差加权的采样修正。在线性子空间去噪模型下，精确的回拉在垂直于数据子空间的方向上不存在分量。蒸馏变分最优控制（DVOC）实现了这一局部控制原理在参数空间中的对应版本：投影奖励上升在局部信任域内构造有界的端点位移，并通过一个稀疏的、前向固定的欧拉代理将其传递到LoRA参数上。实验表明，VOG降低了DiT……
tldr: 本文提出变分最优引导（VOG）与蒸馏变分最优控制（DVOC），将采样时引导和基于奖励的后训练统一在雅可比回拉的几何框架下，通过协方差加权的采样修正和作用于LoRA参数的投影奖励上升，实现生成模型输出空间的改进。
